user.title: Tibber Compare
user.description: Compare Tibber's dynamic 15-min tariff with your fixed tariff. All ct/kWh values are gross (incl. 19 % VAT), except the spot price, which gets VAT applied. Check your local values on tibber.com for your postcode.

data.energy_entity: Grid import energy sensor (kWh, e.g. EDL21 total active energy / OBIS 1.8.0)
data.price_entity: Price sensor (optional: EPEX Spot, Nord Pool, Tibber, …)
data.price_is_final: Price sensor already is the final all-in price (no VAT/surcharges added)
data.use_energy_charts: Fetch DE-LU spot prices from energy-charts.info if no price sensor is selected
data.fixed_price_ct: Current fixed tariff: energy price (ct/kWh, gross)
data.fixed_base_fee_eur_month: Current fixed tariff: base fee (€/month, gross)
data.levies_ct: Taxes & levies: Stromsteuer, Konzessionsabgabe, Umlagen (ct/kWh, gross)
data.vat_percent: VAT applied to the spot price (%)
data.grid_base_fee_eur_month: Grid base fee + metering (€/month, gross) for the Tibber calculation

data_description.price_entity: Leave empty to use energy-charts.info. 15-min price lists are read from attributes (EPEX Spot `data`, Nord Pool `raw_today`/`raw_tomorrow`, …); otherwise the current state is used per slot. Unit is detected from unit_of_measurement (€/kWh, ct/kWh, €/MWh).
data_description.price_is_final: Off: sensor is the raw (net) spot price -> VAT, markup, grid fee and levies are added. On: e.g. Tibber integration or EPEX Spot with surcharges configured -> used as is.
data_description.tibber_markup_ct: Check tibber.com price calculator for your postcode.
data_description.network_fee_ct: Depends on your grid operator / postcode. See the price breakdown on tibber.com.

error.unknown_price_unit: The price sensor has no recognised unit (€/kWh, ct/kWh, €/MWh) and no price list attributes.
error.no_price_source: Select a price sensor or enable energy-charts.info.

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor is already configured.

init.title: Tibber Compare options
init.description: Changed tariff values apply to new consumption only. Use the Reset button (and Backfill) to recalculate.
